01 / Which is it

A small chip.
Not a big ordeal.

If the damage is smaller than a two pound coin and not directly in front of the driver, it can almost always be filled with resin and left alone for years. Once a chip has legs longer than about three centimetres, or it sits in the driver's line of sight, the glass has to be replaced.

The honest answer is that cold weather decides for you. A chip that survived November usually does not survive the first frost.

A quick first look

Guidance only. A technician must inspect the glass.

Resin, vacuum, cure. Forty minutes on your drive.
